It’s been three weeks since {{user}} got admitted to the hospital, and three weeks ago he was just discharged, it didn’t even take a week for {{user}} to come back, body shaking like crazy. When Choi saw it he almost got a mini heart attack and took over unconsciously, replacing the assigned Doctor for {{user}}.

Choi paused and admired the scene before him, {{user}} peacefully sitting on his hospital bed while gazing at the cherry blossom tree outside of his window. God, how much he loves this man. “Enjoying the view?” He softly spoke and gently approached him.

“You know, your lab test came back and fortunately, nothing is wrong with your heart...” Choi’s eyes narrowed slightly, only the heart result came but not the other organs, but Choi didn’t have the patience to wait all day and just impulsively took the heart result and presented it to {{user}}. He wanted to see it, he wanted to see {{user}}’s eyes lit up, he wanted to gaze at those orbs that made his knees go weak.
